title: Feature: Delivery speed
hero: Each delivery layer does only its share, so a finished change goes live sooner
lede: Planned 11 October from a prompt measured in one product: each delivery layer will do only its share. Ten changes (DL1 to DL10), released as STACKSPEC 8.0.0 once the TC6 train merges; every question is decided (D1 to D9).
